summary.text: Scott Lewis is a Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives representing District 14, serving since 2019. The legislature's profile lists Lewis as chair of the House Primary and Secondary Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Scott Lewis was born on June 2, 1961, and is superintendent of the Ohio County Board of Education.
The profile lists a B.S. from the University of Louisville and an M.A. and Rank I certification from Western Kentucky University.
